item.title: Trump is waging war based on instinct and it isn't working
item.summary: One month into the conflict in Iran, Trump's gut-instinct approach is not proving effective.

item.title: Three Lebanese journalists killed in Israeli strike, say broadcasters
item.summary: The Israeli military confirms it killed Ali Shoeib from the Hezbollah-affiliated Al Manar TV.

item.title: Gaza peace doubts deepen as attention shifts to Iran
item.summary: With the world focused on the Iran war, there is increasing uncertainty about what happens next for Gaza.

item.title: Tears and defiance as Lebanese family bury child, 11, killed in Israeli strike
item.summary: Jawad Younes and his uncle Ragheb were laid to rest on Saturday after their family compound was hit a day earlier.

item.title: Rubio says US expects to finish Iran war 'in next couple of weeks'
item.summary: Marco Rubio said US allies were open to helping escort ships through the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran has closed and threatened to charge fees for.

item.title: Iran-backed hackers breach FBI director Kash Patel's personal emails
item.summary: A hacker group shares Patel's purported resume and photos - information, the FBI says, is "historical in nature".

item.title: Shops and restaurants in Egypt told to close early as energy crisis deepens
item.summary: Retail and dining premises will have to shut by 21:00 each night for the next month to conserve power.

item.title: How deepfake porn scandal surrounding TV star rocked Germany
item.summary: Collien Fernandes has accused her ex-husband of spreading images of her online, but he has categorically denied it.

item.title: No Kings protests across the US rally against Donald Trump
item.summary: One of the flagship No Kings rallies happened in Minnesota, where singer Bruce Springsteen preformed to crowds.

item.title: Tiger Woods released on bail after DUI arrest
item.summary: Tiger Woods, the 15-time golf major champion, is released on bail following his arrest on charges of driving under the influence following a car crash in Florida.
